a.xlink:title: Inserts or replaces an entity, keyed by its entity type and number.
Base info lines shared by every entity: identity and position.
Resolves the entity currently followed, auto-detaching if it is gone or not a player.
Selects the entity standing on a tile (preferring players), or clears the selection.
Creates an egg from an enw message (egg laid by a player).
Updates a player's position and orientation from a ppo message.
Creates a Trantorian from a pnw message.
Applies an egg message to the state.
Applies a common entity message to the state.
Applies a Trantorian message to the state.
Info lines: identity, position and owning team.
Info lines: identity, position, team, level and inventory.
Draws one frame from the given state.
Picks the entity under a 2D (top-down) click and updates the selection.
Picks the entity under a 3D click by casting a ray onto the ground.
Polls input and updates the camera and selection.
